perch.name: perch
perch.desc: A striped little fish from the shallows. Better cooked.

trout.name: trout
trout.desc: A sleek fish from deep water. Better cooked.

eel.name: eel
eel.desc: Long and slippery; eels bite at night.

smoked_fish.name: smoked fish
smoked_fish.desc: Smoked through; it keeps for good.

dried_fish.name: dried fish
dried_fish.desc: Dried on a rack in the sun and wind; it keeps for good.

fish_stew.name: fish stew
fish_stew.desc: Fish and herbs simmered in water: a hot, hearty meal.

meat.name: raw meat
meat.desc: Fresh from the hunt. It spoils in about two days unless you cook, smoke or dry it.

hide.name: hide
hide.desc: An animal's skin. Scraped with a knife, it becomes leather.

bone.name: bone
bone.desc: Hard and light. Simmered in water it makes broth.

cooked_meat.name: roast meat
cooked_meat.desc: Hot from the fire and very filling.

smoked_meat.name: smoked meat
smoked_meat.desc: Smoked through; it keeps for good.

jerky.name: jerky
jerky.desc: Meat dried on a rack in the sun and wind; it keeps for good.

meat_stew.name: meat stew
meat_stew.desc: Meat and mushrooms simmered in water: the most filling stew.

meat_pie.name: meat pie
meat_pie.desc: Meat baked in a crust in an oven.

bone_broth.name: bone broth
bone_broth.desc: A warm drink of bones simmered in water.

mushroom.name: mushroom
mushroom.desc: Earthy, a little chewy raw. Roasted, much better.

herbs.name: wild herbs
herbs.desc: Fragrant leaves that make stews and bread taste of something.

flatbread.name: flatbread
flatbread.desc: Quick bread with herbs, baked on the stones of a fire.

berry_pie.name: berry pie
berry_pie.desc: Sweet berries baked in a crust in an oven.

clay_pot.name: clay pot
clay_pot.desc: Fired clay. Fill it with water at a well or the water's edge (fill) and carry the water with you.

water_pot.name: pot of water
water_pot.desc: Fresh water to carry. Drink it anywhere; stews and broth need one in hand.

spear.name: spear
spear.desc: For hunting: carry it to hunt deer, rabbits or boar within 3 steps.

sling.name: sling
sling.desc: For hunting from afar: carry it and some stones to hunt game up to 5 steps away.

oven.name: oven
oven.desc: Place it; pies bake in it.

smoker.name: smoker
smoker.desc: Place it; fish and meat smoked in it keep for good.

drying_rack.name: drying rack
drying_rack.desc: Place it, then store raw meat or fish on it: in dry weather they become jerky or dried fish, which keep for good.

well.name: well
well.desc: Place it: clean water to drink and to fill clay pots, wherever you live.
